self_assessment.weakest_area: Error state UI was added but the error path itself was not exercised end-to-end (couldn't trigger a real shiki failure in the dev environment). Code path inspected and matches the standard try/catch pattern.
self_assessment.hardest_decision: Whether to also reset contentView to 'preview' on cross-skill navigation. Decided not to, because the user's explicit choice (Markdown tab) should persist across skills; resetting rawHtml + rawError is enough to render the new skill's source.

known_limitations: On cross-skill SPA navigation, the page component appears to remount (contentView resets to 'preview'). Either the route key behavior or layout transition is causing remount; the rawHtml reset still triggers correctly on raw change either way.
